column1: # The sampling-rate request: the rates both languages accept and refuse.
# Read by the Rust tests (runner.rs) and the C++ tests (PerfConfig_uTest.cpp
# and the gperf sampling tests, through VERNIER_SHARED_FIXTURE_DIR).
# Tab-separated; only a tab separates fields, so a field may hold a space.
# '#' starts a comment line. A '-' field is empty.
# variable    <the environment variable gperftools reads the rate from>
# noprofiler  <a --profile name that selects no profiler>
# backend     <--profile name> <take|refuse>: whether a rate applies to it
#             given <request> (or none) and started from an environment
#             whose CPUPROFILE_FREQUENCY is <inherited> (or unset) starts the
#             benchmark with <child>; the benchmark, given <request>, decides
#             directly with that request and that CPUPROFILE_FREQUENCY
# In precedence and direct rows a '-' request is none and a '-' variable is
